Game Overview

In Santa Dash, the core idea is straightforward: guide Santa on a thrilling jetpack ride. Skillfully dodge obstacles while collecting presents, testing your reflexes as you survive for as long as possible. How far can you go before Santa's flight is grounded?

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Santa Dash is easy to pick up. Guide Santa on a thrilling jetpack ride! Skillfully dodge obstacles while collecting presents, testing your reflexes as you survive for as long as possible. How far can you go before Santa's flight is grounded?

Related FAQs

What is Santa Dash?

Santa Dash is a free christmas game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

The goal is to guide Santa on a thrilling jetpack ride. Skillfully dodge obstacles while collecting presents, testing your reflexes as you survive for as long as possible.

Yes, Santa Dash is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
